datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Djibouti administrative units to classify acute food insecurity phases using the IPC framework. Geographic data with IPC classifications and scenario projections were compiled for medium-term forecasting in 2011.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity phases based on food security assessments.
